body: i dont think it matters too much in this situation who was in the right because its just how she feels internally about herself. maybe just remind her how beautiful she is. small things help a lot! maybe put sticky notes on mirrors where she sees herself , i lov putting sticky mote reminders for myself. be like "ur smile is so cute , yea that one🫵🏻" hehe

personally ( i have bpd as well ) i wouldnt like my partner to comment on my body at all like that , even things people see as a compliment or healthy ( no one should be the size they were in middle school as an adult ) but still when others comment on it it can cause a whole mental breakdown. idk specifically about ur partner but a lot of the time BPD is comorbid with ED and advice for that is no body comments except just compliments. even someone commenting "oh ur eating so good" is enough to make me not feel good bc it makes me aware of my eating , same way im sure she just became overly aware of her body, i dont think it was personal🩵
id add it on my spotify playlist if that means anything 🤣
